items.difficulty_reason: Relative Mayer-Vietoris for unbounded complexes: represents E by a K-injective complex with injective terms, computes all four pushforwards on it (restriction lemma), and proves the displayed sequence of pushforward complexes is short exact by applying f_* to the j-star sequence of lemma-exact-sequence-j-star and using R^1 f_* I = 0 for injective I; finishes with the identifications a_* = f_* j_{U,*} etc.
